name: Tylegmut's Last Meal
description: The former bank manager's ghostly presence tempts creatures to partake in a dubious meal.
disable: DC 18 Religion check (trained) to say a prayer to Urgathoa and put the haunt temporarily to rest until it resets, DC 22 Occultism check (trained) to commune with the bank manager's spirit and convince her to permanently pass on, disabling the haunt
reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature eats a full meal at the desk-this can be any food, not just the "food" at hand.
routine: (1 action) The haunt sends a cloud of dust and bone shards hurtling about the room. The dust and bones batter all creatures in the room, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save). Creatures who fail the save are Blinded for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Foul Temptation
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks over the contents of the desk

Effect The haunt tempts nearby creatures to eat from the plates and bowls arrayed on the desk by concealing it in an illusion of food the viewer finds delicious. Each creature in area D5 must attempt a DC 21 Will save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature sees through the illusion entirely and is temporarily immune to the haunt's routine for 1 minute.

Success The creature is not tempted by the food.

Failure The creature believes the food is appetizing and becomes driven to consume it. The creature takes 4d4+4 slashing damage as it chews the jagged bones and husks.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is Paralyzed for 1 round as the haunt continues to tempt it.
